svg.aria-label: Staff Attendance & Portal: Check in and out with location checks against the office radius. Staff without a Salesforce login sign in with an emailed code. Corrections need admin approval, and saved days are locked. Reminders, weekly summaries, and public holidays filled in automatically each year.
